name: ami-contact-list-builder
description: Guides architects through building a clean, segmented contact list from email history for Sunshine Island CRM, with optional user-defined project and client-type tags.

interface.shortDescription: Turn email history into a reviewed, CRM-ready contact list.
interface.longDescription: A guided AMI workflow for architects. It asks simple setup questions, runs a small pilot, finds professionally relevant contacts and interactions, suggests AMI relationship segments, applies an optional user-approved set of project or client-type tags, matches likely duplicate identities, formats phone numbers, and prepares a reviewed workbook and CSV for Sunshine Island CRM.
capabilities: Optional project and client niche tagging
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ami-contact-list-builder to build a reviewed contact list from my email history for Sunshine Island CRM.
